verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation and formation service, not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Atlas ships any MCP-client or agent capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
